definitions.physicalLines: Physical lines including comments and blank lines. CRLF and lone CR normalize to LF; a final newline terminates the last line and does not add another. Empty input has zero lines.
definitions.importantDeclarations: Declarations marked important by the existing PostCSS parser. Text in comments, quoted strings, selectors and URLs is excluded.
definitions.distinctHexColors: Valid 3/4/6/8-digit hex color tokens in declaration values, case-insensitive and normalized to eight RGBA digits. Equivalent shorthand/full/opaque forms count once. Comments, strings, selectors and URL contents are excluded.
definitions.gradientFunctions: Occurrences of linear/radial/conic-gradient functions, including repeating and webkit/moz/o-prefixed forms, in declaration values. Names are case-insensitive and CSS escapes are decoded. Comments, strings and URL contents are excluded.

policy: Every current metric must be less than or equal to its saved limit. This checker never updates limits. Lower limits after reviewed CSS removal; do not raise them to accept growth.
